tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] Your plan only works on good days. || Most plans assume you'll have energy, time and a good mood every single day. Then one bad day comes, you skip, and the whole thing quietly falls apart. || [turn] So plan the bad day in advance. Give every habit two versions, the full one, and a smaller one for the days that go wrong. || Training for a five K? The full version is your thirty minute run. The bad day version is an easy fifteen minute walk. || Studying for an exam? The full version is two hours of practice questions. The bad day version is fifteen minutes reviewing your notes. || The rule is simple. On a bad day, you don't skip, you switch. || [land] Because a streak isn't about doing everything every day. It's about never letting one bad day turn into a bad week. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.

scenes.head:
Don't let a bad day
become a bad week.
